description:
There are over 7 billion people on this planet. And by 2050, there will be 2 billion more... many moving into urban centers at an unprecedented rate. Making sure there is enough food, fiber and infrastructure for our rapidly growing world is what we're all about at John Deere. And it's why we're investing in our people and our technology like never before! Here the world's brightest minds are tackling the world's biggest challenges. If you believe one person can make the world a better place, we'll put you to work. RIGHT NOW.
  
  John Deere is an equal opportunity employer, including disabled & veterans. 
   
 Primary Location: United States (US) - Iowa  - Urbandale, IA  
 Function: Product Engineering (CA)
 Title: Robotics Simulation Engineer - 124416  
 Onsite/Remote: Onsite Position 
  
   
  
 Your Responsibilities 
 
  
 As a Robotics Simulation Engineer for ISG , located in Urbandale, IA or Austin, TX,  you join our team building a world class simulation infrastructure to develop and test our Automation and Autonomy tech stack (A&A).  We are looking for someone interested in computer vision, robotics, guidance, machine learning, and simulation.  This position will: 
  
 Support the Automation and Autonomy (A&A) project teams by developing simulations to emulate the environment interfacing with our sensors (camera and lidar) and the physical system interfacing with the embedded software.  Your responsibilities will include supporting MiL, SiL, and HiL ecosystems will perception model components.   
 Work with design teams to determine appropriate simulations to validate system of system, system, and feature requirements. 
 Work with design teams to design the A&A system including sensor selection and placement, traditional computer vision algorithms, and machine learning algorithms. 
 Work with product verification & validation (PV&V) teams to support automated testing for software releases. 
 Support component testing and simulation activities to demonstrate and improve correlation for sensor models, starting with camera models 
  
 VISA Sponsorship is NOT available for this position 


 What Skills You Need 
 
  
 Experience with controls or software testing (MIL, SIL, HIL) 
 Experience with vehicle, sensor, and embedded software simulation 
 Coding skills in python 
 Strong analytic skills with high attention to detail and accuracy 
 Strong, demonstrated problem solving skills 
 Ability and experience working in a self-directed mode, sense of curiosity, and sense of ownership. 
 Ability to manage multiple project schedules and milestones 
 The ability to function in a fast paced, collaborative team environment that is distributed across various time zones and locations  
 

 What Makes You Stand Out 
 
  
 Experience with Matlab Simulink 
 Experience with gaming or robotics simulation software such as Unreal, Unity, IsaacSim, Gazebo, or similar 
 Experience with John Deere’s SiL ecosystem 
 Experience with John Deere’s DSM workflow 
 Experience with camera, radar, lidar, and other perception hardware 
 Experience training and testing machine learning algorithms 
 Experience with computer vision, lidar, or radar 
 Product design experience in the Agriculture, Construction, Forestry, or Off-road equipment industries  
 

 Education 
 
 Ideally you will have a degree or equivalent related work experience in the following: 
  
 Advanced degree in Computer Science, Computer or Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or equivalent degree in a related technology field or discipline. 
 


 What You'll Get 
 At John Deere, you are empowered to create a career that will take you to where you want to go while working in an inclusive team environment. Here, you'll enjoy the freedom to explore new projects, the support to think outside the box and the advanced tools and technology that foster innovation and achievement. Additionally, we offer a comprehensive reward package to help you get started on your new career path, including:
 Flexible work arrangements
 Highly competitive base pay 
 Savings & Retirement benefits (401K and Defined Contribution)
 Healthcare benefits with a generous company contribution in the Health Savings Account
 Adoption assistance
 Employee Assistance Programs
 Tuition assistance
 Fitness subsidies and on-site gyms at specific Deere locations
 Charitable contribution match
 Employee Purchase Plan & numerous discount programs for personal use
 Vacation and Holiday Pay
  $86,892.00  - $130,332.00  + Benefits
 Follow this link to learn more about our Total Rewards Package  https://bit.ly/3XCd8fL  
 Must be 18 years of age or older to apply
